title: Hatsune Miku — A Precious Promise〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That voice...
Is it idol me?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And she's singing the song from that time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I knew it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But what made her want to sing it again?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think I'll go take a look...
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, there she is!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That was amazing, Miku!
That really moved me!
bgm_area00002

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. Also, I didn't realize that this song had such a gentle arrangement.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's a song that we all know, but it felt like something completely new.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, a little change to how you sing it gives off such a new feeling. You're amazing, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
By the way, about that idea you all gave me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is she practicing while having Minori and the others listen?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
They're all so focused.
Minori's even taking notes while listening to what everyone has to say.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The one asking for advice is “me”, but the others are also trying to learn as much as they can from this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's wonderful how they're having such a positive impact on each other.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone!
I feel really good about this song now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I also learned a lot!
I'm really looking forward to seeing you perform it for real!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, why are you so invested in this song?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Remember what I told you about the other SEKAI I was sent to, and the girl whose feelings made it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you said it was basically empty, and that she didn't seem all that happy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I put on a little concert for her in the hopes of cheering her up. But she didn't really smile during my first try.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?! Why not?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Does she not like idols or something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, she seems to be carrying some very heavy thoughts with her. So heavy that she isn't really able to have fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see... There isn't much you can do about that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Mafuyu seems to be doing a little better after going back to stay at Kanade's house, but everything must still feel so recent...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I decided not to give up, and did another show for them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I changed the way I sang that song earlier for that very reason.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's why it felt so gentle and warm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure everyone from that SEKAI is dealing with more hurt and pain than we can really imagine.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I know the ones who can really empathize and be there for them are the “us” from their own SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm an idol.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to help cheer them up, even a little, with the things that I can do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It would have made sense if she felt a bit discouraged, seeing someone not enjoying her show...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But she immediately began thinking of a way to turn things around.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She really is a wonderful idol.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so proud of “myself”.
